questions.question_text: Which blade should you use to select an operating system image when creating a new virtual machine in the Azure portal?
questions.explanation: The Azure portal's 'Create a resource' blade includes the Marketplace where you choose an OS image; see Microsoft documentation on creating a VM.

questions.question_text: When you enable encryption at host for a virtual machine, which of the following is true?

options.label: A
options.text: It requires you to install a VM extension

options.label: C
options.text: It is enabled by default for new VMs

options.label: D
options.text: It encrypts the VM's OS and data disks using platform-managed keys

questions.explanation: Enabling encryption at host uses platform-managed keys to protect OS and data disks; refer to Azure documentation on encryption at host.

questions.question_text: You need to move a running VM from one resource group to another in a different subscription. Which command should you use?

options.label: B
options.text: az resource move --resource-group sourceRG --destination-group destRG --resource-name vmName --resource-type Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines

questions.explanation: Azure resource move operation allows moving a VM between resource groups, subscriptions, or regions; see Azure documentation on moving resources.

questions.question_text: You have a VM sized Standard_D2s_v3 that is experiencing CPU throttling. Which action should you take to address this?

options.label: A
options.text: Resize the VM to a larger size

questions.explanation: CPU throttling indicates the VM size is insufficient; resizing to a larger SKU increases CPU capacity; refer to sizing guidance in Azure documentation.

questions.question_text: When deploying a VM Scale Set for high availability, which configuration ensures the instances are spread across multiple availability zones?

options.label: C
options.text: Specify multiple zones in the upgrade domain

options.label: D
options.text: Set the platform fault domain count

questions.explanation: Zone redundancy in a VM Scale Set spreads instances across availability zones for higher availability; see Azure documentation on zone redundancy.
